title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1243: Its up to su yu (3)

title.p: Chapter 1243: Its up to su yu (3)

section.p: After stopping the furball, Su Yu looked around and noted that the surrounding young geniuses were already greatly exhausted from the battle. In fact, he was pretty tired himself.

Looking at them, he decided that he had to kill a few of them. That would anger the Invincibles and further provoke them. Then, he could snatch the Culture Tomb and carrier treasures before fleeing. That should be enough to make those Invincibles pursue him.
Right!
He also had to take Yellow Nine hostage and force First Yellow to teleport him away. He trusted the stone statue’s words. Yellow Nine must be quite important to First Yellow.

His gaze landed at Yellow Nine who was busy absorbing the heavenly source qi in the ruin as he cursed inwardly. This was a very expensive endeavor for him. He had lost quite a lot of heavenly source qi and sunmoon profound yellow liquid to all these people.

The carrier treasures and Culture Tomb were the only items that were still untouched in the middle of the ruin. Anyone trying to approach the three items would be stopped by the others. That was understandable since the three items were why most of them were here.
“Old Zhu is facing a devil king and a divine king. First Profound is facing a divine king…”
In other words, he should kill a young genius from the divine race to maximize the displeasure he could generate among the Invincibles. Killing a young devil genius would probably work as well.

But the most important devil genius present was Mo Duona, and he had yet to join the battle even now. Meanwhile, Zhan Wushuang, the divine genius, had given him quite a lot of punches during the course of this battle.
Very well. This was Mo Duona’s lucky day. He would be spared. Zhan Wushuang would be the one to die.

Prior to this, Su Yu had mostly been fighting to keep these young geniuses occupied. That was his way of keeping the Invincibles supplying them with power across realms busy. But at this point, he had to prioritize the crisis in the Human Realm. Those in the Allheaven Battlefield would have to rely on themselves for now.

Su Yu shook his head disapprovingly. In the end, it was still up to him to save humanity. Weren’t those geezers supposed to be able to handle this themselves? Wasn’t Wan Tiansheng very confident before this? How unreliable of them. Old Wan wasn’t even that impressive. How could he lose steam after killing only two Invincibles? Su Yu was completely neglecting the fact that Wan Tiansheng was probably one of the handful of people in existence who had killed as many as two Invincibles.
Su Yu clenched his teeth as he prepared to make his move. In truth, his battle against the young geniuses had been ongoing even as he was thinking about all that.
He sent a voice transmission to the nearby Qin Hao, “General Qin, can you hear me?”
Qin Hao was in the middle of being beaten up by a ninth-stage Sunmoon from the celestial chasm race. Of the three number twos, he was the worst off.

If it wasn’t for his resilience, he would have been beaten to death by now. He was actually not weak at all, but he had been fighting for an extended period of time. Earlier, he had received a beating by a Pseudo Invincible. Now, a ninth-stage Sunmoon was giving him a beating as well. He was in a rather bad state.
When he heard Su Yu’s voice, he replied weakly, “Yes? Are you offering to help? Forget it. You seem to have your hands full as well…”
“No. In a moment, could you use more strength and push that Sunmoon away for a bit? With that opening, I need you to stop First Yellow for a split second. I only need a split second.”
Screw that!

Was the little shit aware of what he was saying? Was that a simple task? Pushing a ninth-stage Sunmoon back before dealing with First Yellow? If he was so strong, he would have beaten his opponent to death long ago.
Su Yu sounded very relaxed. He had full confidence in Qin Number Two. Just look at how valiant Qin Number Two looked.

Of the three number twos, Qin Number Two looked the most impressive. Just look at his shiny black armor and ferocious spear. As an eighth-stage Sunmoon, he was able to contend against Pseudo Invincibles. He was more than capable of pushing a ninth-stage Sunmoon back before keeping First Yellow occupied for a split second.
Xia Number Two had killed a Pseudo Invincible. Zhu Number Two had killed an Invincible. Qin Number Two should be able to easily accomplish something like pushing a ninth-stage Sunmoon back, right?
“You can do it, General Qin! This is very important! It concerns the survival of humanity! If you fail, humanity might face destruction today!”
Bullshit!
Qin Number Two cursed inwardly. What nonsense.

Yes, they were probably quite disadvantaged in the Allheaven Battlefield, but in his opinion, they were doing quite well in the Human Realm. Yes, a decent number of myriad race Invincibles had arrived. But they had a decent number of experts on their side as well.
Furthermore, did Su Yu think that he would be the one to save humanity from destruction?
Was that a joke?
But hearing the urgency in Su Yu’s voice, he still clenched his teeth and agreed, “Fine!”
Right after saying that, he wailed miserably. His opponent had just drilled through his arm with a character.
That wail caused Su Yu’s confidence in him to waver.
Would this work?

But this was the strongest help he could recruit nearby. Just look at Administrator Hu and the others. They were being beaten up so badly that Su Yu wasn’t sure if they could even remain alive for long. Qin Number Two was the only one he could rely on.
He clenched his teeth. This was his sole option.

No matter how good an actor Old Zhu was, it was only a matter of time before the two Invincibles started growing suspicious. The moment they attacked, they could blast Old Zhu apart. That would instantly shake the fragile balance of this battlefield.
It was now up to him to save humanity. As he was thinking, Zhan Wushuang landed yet another punch on him, causing him to cough blood.

Zhan Wushuang had a cold expression. He was the strongest among the young geniuses involved in this fight. A majority of the wounds on Su Yu’s body were left by him. Naturally, he had received quite a lot of wounds from the fight as well.
Thus, he was not surprised that he was landing yet another punch on Su Yu.
Su Yu’s speed of recovery was astonishingly fast. He wouldn’t be an easy opponent to kill when both of them were similar in strength. This had essentially turned into a battle of endurance.
On their side, the young geniuses were powered by Invincibles or even Pseudo Emperors. What about Su Yu? Was he relying on death qi? Was he not worried that the death qi would kill him?

It was uncertain who would emerge victorious in this clash between them. As usual, Su Yu rushed toward him madly right after being sent away by a punch. This had happened repeatedly today. Su Yu was too petty to let an attack unanswered.
Zhan Wushuang was not surprised to see the same scene repeating itself. Su Yu pounced on Zhan Wushuang madly, ignoring the many attacks landing on his body by the other young geniuses.
Zhan Wushuang took on the attacks fearlessly. At their level, very few of them were fearful of death. How could they hope to gain more if they were too cowardly to risk themselves?
But this time, Su Yu spent a much longer time than before on Zhan Wushuang. As a result, he was able to deal a lot more damage to Zhan Wushuang at the price of more injuries on his own body.

His calm and tribulation characters were active, numbing Zhan Wushuang’s sense of crisis. Every single one of these young geniuses was extremely sensitive toward danger. The moment they sensed any danger to their lives, they would be able to pull out some trump cards to flee.
Abruptly, Su Yu shifted the target of his tribulation character to Dao Cheng. Instantly, Dao Cheng’s expression changed.
He roared, “Stop him!”
He could sense that Su Yu had designs on his life. His sharp senses were screaming at him. Almost at the same moment, a massive hammer appeared and shot toward him at full power.
“Die!”
Su Yu’s killing intent surged.

Xuan Wuji, Ming Yue, and the others roared as they attempted to intercept the hammer. Some were also sending attacks straight at Su Yu’s head in an attempt to disrupt him. Zhan Wushuang, who had barely recovered from the beating he had just received, charged forth to attack without taking the time to recover from some of his injuries.

Despite the chaotic nature of this battle, there was a consensus among these geniuses. They couldn’t allow Su Yu to kill any one of them. That would make things a lot more dangerous for the rest of them.
Thus, none of them hesitated to help when Dao Cheng was being targeted. The hammer continued charging forth ferociously.
Su Yu roared, “If you allow me to kill him, I won’t get in your way when you’re fighting for the Culture Tomb!”
Everyone ignored him.
“Bastard!”

Su Yu roared with frustration, demonstrating his determination to kill Dao Cheng at all costs. That further triggered Dao Cheng’s danger sense, which was further amplified by the tribulation character.
He could sense that he was in great danger.
He roared with desperation, “Kill him!”
He was certain of Su Yu’s determination to kill him.

Meanwhile, Zhan Wushuang was swiftly approaching Su Yu’s back. His danger sense was quite subdued, with only the occasional warnings of danger. But that was normal when he was in battle with so many young geniuses. Thus, he didn’t think much about it.

Right at that moment, Su Yu squeezed everything he could from his yang acupoint, consumed a drop of blood essence, and activated the Divine Transformation and Devil’s Descend abilities, before manifesting a five elemental cage around Zhan Wushuang.

Finally, he utilized a different ability to manifest four more arms on his back. Each of the arms made a fist before punching at Zhan Wushuang. Zhan Wushuang resisted with a roar. Just as the five elemental cage was about to break apart, a tiny furball appeared with a flicker before giving his sea of willpower a bite.
Wave after wave of death qi rippled out as the four arms threw countless punches toward Zhan Wushuang.
“Sky! Sunder!”
144 of Su Yu’s acupoints erupted with Xia Longwu’s saber qi. This was his first time using the transformed saber qi at full power.
A radiant blade appeared in the sky.

Even Marquis Xia’s saber qi nearly responded to that blade. When he looked down, he cursed. Why did that saber qi feel even stronger than his own saber qi? Or to be precise, Su Yu’s saber qi was of a much higher quality and purity. It almost felt like Xia Longwu was the one attacking instead of Su Yu.

With two of the hands bringing the humming blade down, the other two hands punched at Zhan Wushuang. Zhan Wushuang’s expression changed drastically. He instantly ignited his blood essence and Divine Transformation ability. Alas, he was too late.

First, the two fists landed, leaving two holes on his body. Then, the blade cleaved him into two. His sea of willpower appeared only to be swallowed by the little furball in one bite. Worried that the divines would not give chase if Zhan Wushuang was dead, he decided to keep Zhan Wushuang alive for now.
“Digest him later.”
The little furball said nothing and returned to Su Yu’s sea of willpower.

The others were stunned by the sudden change. However, their attacks did not stop. As their attacks struck Su Yu, blasting his flesh apart and breaking his bones, he turned into a gust of wind before vanishing with the Culture Tomb and two carrier treasures.

Anyone else wouldn’t be able to catch the two carrier treasures so easily, but that wasn’t an issue for him since he was the one who had placed the two into the ruin. Prior to this, he had left his willpower imprints on both carrier treasures.
As for the Culture Tomb, he had an odd sensation when he grabbed it as he found his willpower imprint missing. Why was it gone? But he did not have the time to think about it.

The moment he vanished with the three items, Qin Hao roared and threw a punch while coughing blood. He attacked madly, as though he was about to detonate himself. Alarmed, his opponent hurriedly pulled back. Right at that moment, Qin Hao spun his spear around and stabbed it at First Yellow.
Noticing the incoming spear, First Yellow cursed inwardly. Why was that madman attacking him out of nowhere? He hadn’t even been involved in the battle!
Not interested in fighting Qin Hao, he took a step back. He already had the real Culture Tomb in hand. There was no point in fighting. In fact, he was already looking for an opportunity to slip off.

But right after he took that step back, his expression changed. Su Yu had appeared beside him with a flicker before grabbing Yellow Nine. A miserable wail rang out as Yellow Nine’s arm was dislocated by Su Yu.
She wasn’t weak, but she was no match for a monster like Su Yu. The gap between them was too big.

This attack came as a complete surprise to her. Instead of killing the other young geniuses, why was Su Yu attacking her? She felt like coughing blood from sheer frustration. Was Su Yu still holding a grudge toward her over what she said while they were both members of the pavilion? Was he taking his revenge on her for that?
Alarmed, First Yellow shouted, “She’s—”
“Teleport me away! Now!” Su Yu couldn’t be bothered to say more. He sent the coordinate over and said, “Do it or I’ll kill Yellow Nine!”
First Yellow was rendered speechless. He knew what was happening. This guy was taking Yellow Nine hostage. Was he trying to run with the treasures?
Fine, fine. First Yellow was happy to oblige.
He ripped the space beside him apart and said, “Go. Do not harm her.”

Su Yu wasted no time and stepped into the spatial tear. Outside the ruin, the expressions of the two divine kings changed. Zhan Wushuang’s physical body had been destroyed. The Culture Tomb had also been snatched by Su Yu. And he was escaping.
Zhan Wushuang had yet to die. His sea of willpower had yet to be destroyed. Including the Culture Tomb and the two carrier treasures, Su Yu became an incredibly attractive target.
The divine king who was fighting Zhu Tiandao left without any hesitation.
Zhu Tiandao exhaled in relief. After taking a moment to think about it, he gnashed his teeth and rushed off while roaring, “Audacious! Don’t even dream of harming Su Yu!”
Inwardly, he was cursing as well. Yes, Su Yu’s actions had helped him. But running away with the best treasures of the ruin was the same as throwing his life away. What was that kid thinking?
Zhu Tiandao felt miserable. He felt like he was in deep trouble. Was he supposed to fight when Su Yu was inevitably caught by the divine king?
If he did nothing, Su Yu would die.
If he did something, both of them would die.
Shit! Shit! Shit!
Why was that little shit still thinking about those treasures at a time like this?
Fine, fine. If they must die, so be it.

Helpless, Zhu Tiandao decided to think on the bright side. At least this way, his real strength would only be exposed further away from this place. That delay might give the other humans the chance to flee. It was unlikely that they would be able to flee in time if his real strength was exposed here.

Meanwhile, Devil King Mohe was exhaling in relief. Inwardly, he cursed at the divine king. That bastard had rushed off so suddenly, giving him a scare as he thought that this would be Zhu Tiandao’s chance to kill him. As for now, he was left with no choice but to give chase as well. If he allowed the divine king to face Zhu Tiandao alone, Zhu Tiandao could very well kill the divine king before returning to kill him.
Not far away, Devil King Lade roared and joined the pursuit as well. He desperately needed the carrier treasures and Culture Tomb. He needed those treasures to regain his tri-life bodies.
Wan Tiansheng and Lan Tian also joined the pursuit even as they were coughing blood endlessly.
Why was Su Yu making trouble at a time like this?

Wasn’t it agreed that the ruin and the treasures would serve as bait? Why was the kid running off with his own treasures? They only needed to wait. The moment Zhu Tiandao or Great Han King won, they would be able to defeat the rest of their opponents.
Wan Tiansheng even wondered if Su Yu had decided to retrieve his own treasures after seeing that they were already on the verge of winning.
What a troublesome kid.
